title: Natural normalized currying from native product Hom representatives
statement: Let l be prime, Y any scheme and A its native module category. Let H:D(A)^op × D(A)→D(A) and R be NativeHomRepresentatives for ordinaryIhomBifunctor, as in [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. Suppose model(P,Q): Q(Q) tensor Q(P) ≅ Q(ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q)) is given whenever P is NativeOrdinaryKFlat and is natural on complex maps f:P→P' and g:Q→Q' for K-flat P,P'. Then there are bijections e(T,P,I): Hom(T tensor P,I) ≃ Hom(T,H(P,I)) for all derived T,P,I. Their inverses satisfy e(T',P',I')^{-1}(f;phi;H(g,h)) = (f tensor g);e(T,P,I)^{-1}(phi);h for all derived f:T'→T, g:P'→P, h:I→I'. For K-flat complexes P,Q, K-injective I and a chain map phi:Q→bifunctorHomObj(P,I), there exists a chain map psi:ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q)→I whose (p,q) component is the unsigned ordinary tensor-Hom counit applied to phi_q followed by the (q,p,p+q) Hom projection. Furthermore model(P,Q);Q(psi) = e(Q(Q),Q(P),Q(I))^{-1}(Q(phi);R.model(P,I)^{-1}). No closed structure, adjunction or symmetry is part of this conclusion.

source.place: Tags 08J9, 0A90, 0A8Z and 0A97: tensor-Hom bijection, homotopy classes and evaluation; native transport step 1, Hom comparison. Labels lemma-internal-hom, lemma-compose, equation-global-cohomology-hom-complex and lemma-internal-hom-evaluate.

proof.text: Work directly in an abstract native module-object category. The underived adjunction Mod.ihomAdjunction, with its precomposition mate, is parametrized by the right tensor factor. Define currying and uncurrying for degree-n cochains by multiplying the (p,q) component by (-1)^(p*n). Products and coproducts give inverse additive maps. Expanding the total differential and the native row-sign Hom differential shows that these maps commute with the cochain differential. On degree-zero cocycles obtain inverse bijections of chain maps, with unsigned counit components; on degree-minus-one cochains obtain preservation of homotopies.

For acyclic N and K-flat P, the total(P,N) is acyclic by definition. A map N to Hom(P,I) uncurries to a map total(P,N) to the K-injective I and is null-homotopic. Currying the homotopy proves that Hom(P,I) is K-injective. The standard bijection from homotopy maps into a K-injective to derived maps therefore turns the chain/homotopy bijection into a derived Hom equivalence on representatives. Compose with the supplied tensor model and inverse of R.model. Surjectivity from chain maps into K-injectives, chain-level naturality, hn and R.naturality prove three-variable inverse-currying naturality on representatives.

Use the proved ordinaryTotalIso to identify native acyclic-test K-flatness with the K-flatness satisfied by functorial flat resolutions. Lift the reduced flat resolution functor to the full subcategory of native K-flat complexes. Its quasi-isomorphic augmentation proves that the inclusion followed by Q localizes at the restricted quasi-isomorphisms. Grothendieck K-injective resolutions give the K-injective localization in the target. Combine it with this K-flat localization and Q on arbitrary source complexes by product and opposite localization.

Regard the inverse representative equivalences as a natural isomorphism between the restrictions of the two derived Hom functors. Fully faithful restriction along the product localization lifts it to a natural isomorphism on all derived objects. Its component equivalences give e; its naturality is exactly the required inverse-currying equation. The map-preimage law of fully faithful restriction proves that its restriction is the representative isomorphism with which it was constructed.

For the input phi take the actual degree-zero uncurried chain map psi. The chain-level component calculation gives the unsigned homogeneous counit formula. Restricting the lifted Hom isomorphism back to (Q,P,I) and evaluating its inverse-currying map at Q(phi);R.model.inv yields model.hom;Q(psi), proving the final equation. Specialize the abstract native module calculation to ProEtale.AdicSheaf. No scalar forgetting or section-ring equivalence is required; the calculation also covers zero complexes and the empty scheme.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A90, 0A8Z, 08J9 and 0A97; direct native parametrized tensor-Hom calculation and product-localization descent. Chain calculation follows the existing DerivedNativeTensorProof private calculation, re-established here without its cyclic downstream import.

mathlib_searches.query: The derived tensor product of sheaves of modules is adjoint to product total internal Hom, with natural currying on K-flat and K-injective representatives
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits including ihom.adjunction, internalHomAdjunction₂ and ModuleCat.monoidalClosedHomEquiv. These give underived closedness, not the prescribed native product-total normalization.

mathlib_searches.query: Transport a closed monoidal adjunction from natural Hom equivalences on K-flat representatives through localization
mathlib_searches.results: Adjunction.localization and generic monoidal localization found; they do not supply the native total tensor comparison or the row-sign Hom normalization.
Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv and its homEquiv/counit formulas found; these are used in the proved parent assembly, after the analytic bijections are supplied.

msearch grep returned nine Mathlib occurrences of mapBifunctorFlipIso and its component/naturality formulas. Local rg over WeilConjectures and Sheaf found the existing right-adjoint identification, ringed adjunction and tensor models, but no exact native representative conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem native_ordinary_representative_currying
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (H : (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))ᵒᵖ ×
      DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))
    (R : NativeHomRepresentatives (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) H)
    (model : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
      NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P →
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q)))
    (hn : ∀ (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
      (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hP' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P')
      (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map g ⊗ₘ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫ (model P' Q' hP').hom =
        (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ))) :
    ∃ e : ∀ T P I : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y),
      (T ⊗ P ⟶ I) ≃ (T ⟶ H.obj (op P, I)),
      (∀ (T T' P P' I I' : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y))
        (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : P' ⟶ P) (h : I ⟶ I') (φ : T ⟶ H.obj (op P, I)),
        (e T' P' I').symm (f ≫ φ ≫ H.map (Prod.mkHom g.op h)) =
          (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ (e T P I).symm φ ≫ h) ∧
      (∀ (P Q I : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (_hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q)
        (hI : I.IsKInjective)
        (φ : Q ⟶ CochainComplex.bifunctorHomObj (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) P I),
        ∃ ψ : ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q ⟶ I,
          (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
            HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y)
                (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ≫ ψ.f n =
              ((ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y).obj (P.X p)).map (φ.f q ≫
                  CochainComplex.bifunctorHomπ (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l Y) P I q p n hpq) ≫
                (Mod.ihomAdjunction (P.X p)).counit.app (I.X n)) ∧
          (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ψ =
            (e (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).symm
                (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫ (R.model P I hI).inv))
